# Journal Entry

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:JournalEntry`](gmeow-JournalEntry.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/JournalEntry>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)
